meta.title: Bestim Connect: every company vehicle in one dashboard
meta.description: Drivers log maintenance by voice in the app, and you follow every vehicle, its cost and its next service from one dashboard.

hero.body: Drivers log maintenance by voice in seconds, and you see every vehicle: its condition, its cost and its next service.
hero.phoneAlt: The review screen for a maintenance record in the Bestim app

dash.alt: The Bestim Connect dashboard: a fleet overview with each vehicle's status and cost
dash.title: Fleet overview

problems.title1: Running a fleet on paper and spreadsheets

items.title: Scattered records
items.body: Receipts in a drawer, a spreadsheet with every supervisor, and details only the driver knows.

items.title: Missed services become breakdowns
items.body: A late oil change today is a breakdown on the road tomorrow, and a delivery that arrives late.

items.title: No idea what each vehicle costs
items.body: Which vehicle costs the most? Which one is it time to sell? The answer needs numbers.

driver.title: Logged in seconds, by voice
points: They say what they did the way they'd tell a colleague, and the app sorts out the service, odometer and cost
They photograph the receipt and attach it to the record
Works offline, and uploads the record when the connection is back
driver.alt: The voice logging screen in the Bestim app

manager.title: The whole fleet in front of you
points: Every vehicle's condition and next service
The cost of each vehicle, month by month
An alert ahead of time, for you and the driver

steps.title2: and your fleet is under control.

items.title: Add your vehicles and invite drivers
items.body: We help you enter the vehicles, and every driver gets an invite on their phone.

items.title: Drivers log in seconds
items.body: After each service they say it or type it, and attach a photo of the receipt.

items.title: You see everything
items.body: Records, costs and alerts show up in your dashboard as they happen.

fleet.title: The whole fleet on one screen
fleet.body: Vehicles, drivers, odometers and the next service, in one clear table.

cost.title: The cost of every vehicle
cost.body: A clear total and monthly bars, so you know where the maintenance budget goes.

reminders.title: Alerts for the entire fleet
reminders.body: Vehicles that need your attention show up first.

trust.title: Records you can trust
trust.body: When a record is edited the original stays saved with the correction beside it, and odometer readings that don't add up are flagged for review.

receipts.title: The receipt stays with the record
receipts.body: A photo of every receipt is kept next to the service it paid for.

reports.title: Reports, ready to go
reports.body: Export any vehicle's history as PDF or CSV, for accounting or when you sell.

units.title: By kilometers or operating hours
units.body: Cars, trucks, motorcycles and equipment, all in one account.

facts.label: export formats: PDF, CSV and JSON

workshops.title2: Put your name on your work.
workshops.body: Log the service on your customer's car and it appears in the car's history, verified by your workshop. Your customer trusts you more, and comes back.
points: The service is verified in your workshop's name
It shows in the car's history inside the customer's app
A verified history reassures the buyer at sale time
workshops.cta: Book a demo for your workshop

items.q: Do we need to install devices in the vehicles?
items.a: No. Bestim Connect runs from an app on the driver's phone and a dashboard in your browser. No hardware, no installation.
No. The driver says what they did in their own words, and the app sorts out the details and shows them for review before saving.
Cars, trucks, motorcycles and equipment. Tracked by kilometers or by operating hours.
Yes. Your fleet's data is seen only by the people you give access to inside your company.
Yes. Export any vehicle's history as PDF, CSV or JSON at any time.
Book a demo with the form at the end of this page. We get in touch, show you the dashboard, and help you add your vehicles and drivers.
